subject: Lines inside the boxes of PA graph

messages.author: c89471eda5dca12c
messages.subject: Lines inside the boxes of PA graph
parts:
I am building a PA model using lavaan with the command:

pa.model <- lavaan::sem(paModel, data = data.to.work, ordered =c(", ordered.variables, "))

Then print the graph with:

 semPlot::semPaths(pa.model, style="lisrel", whatLabels = "std", edge.label.cex = .8, label.prop=0.9, rotation = 1,
                      node.width = 1, edge.width = 1, shapeLat = "ellipse", sizeMan = 6, sizeInt = 3, sizeLat = 6,
                      curve=2, , unCol = "#070b8c")

So some of boxes has a line inside like in SMK, ALC and BMI variables in the figure below


Somebody would help in remove this lines please ?

messages.author: 5d4f9e7f97c21008
messages.subject: Re: Lines inside the boxes of PA graph
parts:
I believe those lines represent the thresholds for each variables. Including thresholds=FALSE should remove them from the plot.

Alex
